turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is FedEx customer service. Your international parcel has been held at customs.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The parcel contains prohibited items and you need to pay customs duty of 45,000 rupees immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If not paid within 2 hours, the parcel will be seized and legal action will be taken against you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please transfer the amount to this account to release your parcel. This is a government account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not discuss this with anyone. It's a confidential customs matter.
